cashTse.title: Cash and TSE
cashTse.text: In Germany, anyone who accepts cash with an electronic till needs a certified TSE (technical security system) under the Kassensicherungsverordnung. The TSE integration for OpenEOS is in progress. Until then, your club decides for itself whether to record cash with OpenEOS – if in doubt, check with your tax advisor. Without cash, no TSE is needed: switch on cashless mode for that.
